why_selected: Current public page contains objective commercial claims without recorded prior evidence
artifact_use: Constrain public copy metadata schema ads and page contracts
decision_rule: Publish only claims whose scope and evidence are explicitly approved
exit_criterion: Every objective claim is approved within scope or blocked/removed

why_selected: Partner removal/install and offline filter handling determine what the site can promise and what CRM must record
artifact_use: Align qualification form CRM stages partner handoff and follow-up
decision_rule: A website promise is allowed only when the operational path has an owner and recovery state
exit_criterion: Critical scenarios and partner/customer handoffs are confirmed by Luka/Danik

why_selected: ROI and provider feedback depend on row-level persistence stages deduplication consent and retries
artifact_use: Define exactly which reports and provider events may be trusted
decision_rule: Only end-to-end observed scenarios enter verified_measurement_scope
exit_criterion: Every critical scenario is traced or explicitly limited

why_selected: One multilingual landing currently owns all service demand and future expansion needs evidence
artifact_use: Decide whether one page per language remains sufficient or a distinct owner is justified
decision_rule: Create a new indexable owner only for distinct evidenced task/search utility and approved capability
exit_criterion: Every material intent has one purposeful owner or an explicit no-page decision

why_selected: Live multilingual URLs forms ads and integrations can be harmed by structural changes
artifact_use: Constrain all future route domain renderer and language changes
decision_rule: No route changes until the union legacy inventory and owner decisions are complete
exit_criterion: Every discovered legacy URL and ad destination has one tested decision

why_selected: Hard quality defects must be fixed before cosmetic CRO or experiments
artifact_use: Create mandatory implementation and staging defects ahead of optional growth work
decision_rule: Mandatory accessibility rendering privacy and search defects are fixed or explicitly time-bounded by an authorized owner
exit_criterion: Critical tasks and templates meet the approved target
